artifact - the 2-word quote 'My God' glosses the Hebrew bound to oshb:Ps.83.14; the only web: ref within 200 chars is web:Ps.83.12 (proximity binding). The row's own rationale cites web:Ps.83.13 = oshb:Ps.83.14 correctly
